hero.subtitle: Développement Solidaire
hero.description: Improving the well-being of vulnerable populations through healthcare, sustainable development and the fight against climate change.

mission.title:
Acting for the most
vulnerable populations
mission.description: Founded in 2019 in Paris, DSS works to improve the general well-being of communities through three complementary pillars of action.

health.title: Health & Care
health.desc: Setting up prevention and medical care activities for vulnerable populations. Access to essential care and medical support.

agriculture.title: Sustainable Development
agriculture.desc: Sustainable agriculture and environmental protection projects. Supporting communities for a resilient future in the face of climate challenges.

climate.title: Fighting Climate Change
climate.desc: Promoting the active participation of individuals and communities in the fight against climate change in West Africa.

transparency.label: Transparency
transparency.desc: Every donation tracked in real time

jappoo.title: Jappoo Faju
jappoo.desc: Medical solidarity platform connecting donors and Senegalese patients in urgent need. Donations via Wave, Orange Money and bank card.

jardins.title: Solidarity Gardens
jardins.desc: Supporting family farming in Senegal with sustainable techniques resilient to climate variability.

reforestation.title: Community Reforestation
reforestation.desc: Reforestation program involving local communities in the protection of their natural environment.

jappooSection.title: Jappoo Faju —
jappooSection.subtitle: Help me heal
jappooSection.p1: Jappoo Faju ("help me heal" in Wolof) is our digital medical solidarity platform dedicated to Senegalese patients in need.
jappooSection.p2: Partner hospitals submit requests validated by our team. Every donation is tracked in real time for full transparency.

transparent.title: 100% transparent
transparent.desc: Every donation tracked in real time

workflow.title:
From patient to donor —
a transparent process
workflow.description: Every euro donated is tracked end-to-end. Here is how the Jappoo Faju medical solidarity chain works.
workflow.ctaText: Ready to help a Senegalese patient today?

s1.title: Medical request
s1.desc: A hospitalised patient needs financial help for their care. The partner hospital identifies the need.

s2.title: DSS validation
s2.desc: Our team reviews each case: medical urgency, financial situation, approved partner structure.

s3.title: Publication
s3.desc: The validated request is published on Jappoo Faju with the patient's pseudonym and medical details.

s4.title: Mobilisation
s4.desc: Donors choose the patient they wish to help and make a secure online donation.

s5.title: Care
s5.desc: Funding is paid directly to the hospital. The patient receives the care they need.

s6.title: Traceability
s6.desc: Every donation is documented and reported. Full transparency for donors and partners.

donation.title: Support our work
donation.description: Every donation directly funds our health and sustainable development programmes in Senegal. Choose your amount below.

partners.title:
Trusted hospitals
by our side
partners.description: Our partner hospitals are rigorously selected to guarantee the quality and traceability of every funded intervention.
partners.ctaDesc: Join the DSS network and give your patients access to medical solidarity donations.

fann.name: Fann Hospital
fann.desc: National university hospital of reference, pioneer in welcoming and treating vulnerable patients.

dalalJamm.name: Dalal Jamm
dalalJamm.desc: Healthcare institution committed to universal access to care, a key partner of the Jappoo Faju initiative.
